title: orthocarpus pusillus var. densiusculus
intro: Orthocarpus pusillus var. densiusculus, commonly known as Oregon gilyflower, is a rare variety of the Orthocarpus pusillus plant, belonging to the Orobanchaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to support the immune system and has been found to exhibit anti-inflammatory properties, which may contribute to its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Oregon gilyflower include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which may be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including phenolic compounds and alkaloids. However, further research is necessary to fully understand the health benefits and therapeutic actions of this plant.
